fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch id of the reporting branch

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: SUB COUNTY ID
fields.description: SUB County code of the county where the reporting branch is located

fields.name: CURRENCY CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: DENOMINATION
fields.description: Notes and coins per the denominations of Kenyan currency {1,2,3,…….n}

fields.name: FIT UNITS
fields.description: No of pieces/ units held of fit currency. The default value is zero (0) in case of no value exists.

fields.name: UNFIT UNITS
fields.description: No of pieces/ units held of unfit currency.The default value is zero (0) in case of no value exists.
